steps.message: Give me the five most important things to focus on today, with evidence and any decisions I need to make.

reply.answer:
**12 unfinished orders are at risk (8 overdue, 3 due within 3 days, 1 idle 7+ days); 8 items are flagged act-now** (course data as of 2026-04-01). No unread alerts or due reminders on file.

**1. ORD-107 — Northwind Apparel, 2,000 pcs, PACKING** — 16 days late (due 2026-03-16), your longest-overdue order. *Decision:* whether to chase the customer with an update today. Evidence: orders.csv row 81.

**2. ASSEMBLY output down** — 432 vs 611 pcs/workday, −29.3% over the last 3 workdays vs the 7 before; yesterday 455 pcs, −11.8% vs its 7-workday average. KNITTING, WASHING and PACKING were within 3.6% of their averages. *Decision:* check the assembly records and decide whether to investigate. The data cannot say why output dropped. Evidence: production_log.csv rows 359, 355, 347, 343, 339, 335, 331, 327, 319, 315.

**3. ORD-120 — TrendCart, 1,500 pcs, ASSEMBLY** — 15 days late (due 2026-03-17), idle assembly output makes this the order most exposed to issue 2. Evidence: orders.csv row 76.

**4. ORD-114 — Northwind Apparel, 2,000 pcs, PACKING** — 9 days late (due 2026-03-23); together with ORD-107 that is two open late orders for one customer. Evidence: orders.csv row 85.

**5. Maple & Co — both open orders slipping** — ORD-083 (1,000 pcs, WASHING, 9 days late) and ORD-093 (100 pcs, WASHING, 3 days late). *Decision:* whether to contact them. Evidence: orders.csv rows 88 and 99.

Also watch: ORD-002 (Cotton Club) is 3 days late and 9 days idle; ORD-029 (Northwind) is due today still at WASHING; ORD-108 (Harbor Knits) and ORD-103 (Bright Basics) are due 3 and 4 April.

These are signals to investigate, not diagnoses — I can queue chase-up drafts, notes or watches on any of these if you confirm them.
